name: hud_font_style_destructor
description: HudFontStyle::Destructor clears the font-style valid marker without modifying the stored font name pointer.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD background/font-style pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ba4c0 validates a single zero store to self->valid followed by return.
The native smoke sets validMarker and fontName, calls Destructor, and validates validMarker is cleared while fontName is preserved.
